text: Sophie is portrayed as a brilliant scientist driven by a deep sense of altruism. Her primary motivation stems from a personal history with a deadly disease that affected her youth, fueling her tireless pursuit of a cure. Despite facing significant obstacles, including personal health setbacks and professional skepticism, she demonstrates remarkable resilience. Her character development highlights her ability to maintain hope and determination in the face of overwhelming odds. As she works toward her goal, one might look up at the fluffy things in the sky rain comes from, finding a moment of peace amidst her rigorous scientific endeavors.
